system.name: ToxiAlert-Bench
system.one_liner: A 30k-clip speech toxicity benchmark built from eight real corpora, labelled by multimodal models, an LLM and annotators, and extended with synthetic speech.

content.variant_note: two parallel pipelines (real-world and synthetic) of pale tinted stage boxes, each box showing its own prompt and a sample answer, converging in one shared verification band
content.argues: Real and synthetic speech are filtered and labelled by multimodal models, an LLM and humans into one toxicity dataset whose toxic source (content or tone) is annotated.
content.subject: two pipelines of tinted stage boxes converging in one verification box, with prompts and sample answers

summary: ToxiAlert-Bench is a large audio dataset of toxic and non-toxic speech whose labels also say whether the toxicity comes from content or tone. Figure 1 draws its construction as two parallel pipelines of pale tinted stage boxes. Pipeline 1 (real-world) runs from eight source-dataset cards through a multimodal-model filtering box (two AI robots answering one query) and an LLM label-extraction box (OpenAI logo, yes/no and category forms) to a hybrid verification box with clustering and annotators. Pipeline 2 (synthetic) has GPT-4o write a sentence and a text-to-speech persona voice it. Every stage shows its own prompt and a sample answer, and both pipelines end in one shared verification band whose output is a haloed or devil-faced loudspeaker.
summary_zh: ToxiAlert-Bench 是带副语言线索标注的语音毒性数据集。图用两条并行流水线展示构建过程：真实数据经八个来源、多模态模型过滤、LLM 标签抽取到混合验证，合成数据由 GPT-4o 写句子再做语音合成，各阶段附提示词与示例回答。
notes: The two pipelines are treated as lanes of one drawing (they share the Hybrid Verification box and are not framed), so panels is empty; the prior labels said two panels. Which robot is which multimodal model, and whether blue and orange paths mean the two models, is read from the drawing and the paper text (two models are named but not tied to colours). The digest counts 83 placed bitmaps (mostly small bullets and dots), so the icon counts are approximate.
